id:arXiv:2410.14740.title: Harnessing Your DRAM and SSD for Sustainable and Accessible LLM Inference with Mixed-Precision and Multi-level Caching
id:arXiv:2410.14740.rejection_reason: HBM/DRAM/SSD三層cacheを扱いscope適合性はあるが、mixed-precision・sparsityを含むresource-constrained deployment全体が主眼で、今回採用したstorage-specific system contributionsより新規性・比較優先度が低い。

identity_tokens: title:ianus integrated accelerator based on npupim unified memory system
id:arXiv:2410.15008.title: IANUS: Integrated Accelerator based on NPU-PIM Unified Memory System
id:arXiv:2410.15008.rejection_reason: NPU-PIM unified memoryとPIM access schedulingは関連するが、専用accelerator architectureが中心で、SSD/NVMeやserving runtimeへの接続が弱いため今回のcandidate poolでは見送る。
id:arXiv:2410.15008.axis: Compute-in-Flash・SSD weight offload・near-storage processing・heterogeneous memory hardware

identity_tokens: title:firp faster llm inference via future intermediate representation prediction
id:arXiv:2410.20488.title: FIRP: Faster LLM inference via future intermediate representation prediction
id:arXiv:2410.20488.rejection_reason: speculative decoding高速化として関連するが、future hidden-state predictionというmodel-method寄りの寄与が中心で、今回のserving/runtime system軸では優先度が低い。

identity_tokens: title:pimai a novel architecture for highefficiency llm inference
id:arXiv:2411.17309.title: PIM-AI: A Novel Architecture for High-Efficiency LLM Inference
id:arXiv:2411.17309.rejection_reason: LLM inference向けPIMとして関連するが、今回のstorage/offload軸ではDDR5/LPDDR5 PIM architectureとsimulator評価が中心で、SSD/NVMe・階層memory managementへの直接性が採用候補より弱い。
id:arXiv:2411.17309.axis: Compute-in-Flash・SSD weight offload・near-storage processing・heterogeneous memory hardware

identity_tokens: title:hpim heterogeneous processinginmemorybased accelerator for large language models inference
id:arXiv:2509.12993.title: HPIM: Heterogeneous Processing-In-Memory-based Accelerator for Large Language Models Inference
id:arXiv:2509.12993.rejection_reason: SRAM-PIM/HBM-PIMの専用accelerator co-designで、主評価もcycle-accurate simulation。memory-centric inferenceには関連するが、現サーベイのsystem/offload重点では採用候補より優先度が低い。
id:arXiv:2509.12993.axis: Compute-in-Flash・SSD weight offload・near-storage processing・heterogeneous memory hardware

id:arXiv:2510.02675.axis: Compute-in-Flash・SSD weight offload・near-storage processing・heterogeneous memory hardware

id:arXiv:2609.14320.title: SpectralShift: Effective Context Window Extension of Gated DeltaNet via Spectral Reparameterization
